name: Kajabi
description_en:
Kajabi is a hosted platform for selling knowledge products through courses, coaching, communities, newsletters, downloads and related website/email/checkout tools. Its central commerce distinction is between a Product, which contains the delivery experience, and an Offer, which connects one or more Products to pricing and checkout.

It is broader than a page CMS, but subscription price is only part of the cost. Product/contact/site/admin quotas, payment processing, eligible third-party processor fees and AI capacity affect the final scope. A no-revenue-share headline should be read with the actual fee table and regional conditions.
description_zh:
Kajabi是销售知识产品的托管平台，涵盖课程、辅导、社区、通讯、下载及相关网站/邮件/结账工具。商业核心需区分Product（交付体验）与Offer（将一个或多个Product连接价格及结账）。

它比页面CMS更广，但订阅只是部分成本，产品/联系人/站点/管理员额度、支付处理、适用第三方处理费及AI容量都会影响范围。“不抽收入”宣传需结合实际费用表及区域条件理解。

core_features.explanation_en: Build a delivery product, then select one or more products in an Offer and configure pricing or free access.
core_features.explanation_zh: 先建交付产品，再在Offer选择一个或多个产品，配置价格或免费访问。

core_features.name_zh: 网站、邮件及自动化工具
core_features.explanation_en: Hosted pages, marketing emails and trigger/action automation can support a product launch, with feature access determined by the plan.
core_features.explanation_zh: 托管页面、营销邮件及触发/动作自动化可支持发布产品，具体功能访问取决于套餐。

core_features.explanation_en: Plans vary by products, contacts, websites, communities, admins and AI allowances; unlimited in one dimension does not remove other limits.
core_features.explanation_zh: 套餐按产品、联系人、网站、社区、管理员及AI额度划分，单项无限不免除其他限制。

pricing.summary_zh: 显示月付Basic$179/Growth$249/Pro$499；年付高亮月均$143/$199/$399，但邻近说明冲突，需结账确认。另有支付处理、区域适用第三方费及联系人/AI扩容。

official_check.scope: Public primary sources read; no account, purchase, integration execution, performance benchmark, owner identity or publication approval tested.

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from the attached primary sources. Vendor documentation does not establish independent testing or customer outcomes.
Original directory feature labels were replaced with product-specific documented capabilities. Unknowns and unreviewed alternatives remain unknown.

sections.title_en: Build the product and checkout as separate objects
sections.title_zh: 将产品和结账作为不同对象构建
sections.en:
For an illustrative workshop business, create the course or coaching experience first, then define the Offer used to sell it. The detailed guide has an administrator open Sales > Pricing > New Offer, enter a title, choose the Product(s), set a price if a payment provider is connected or make it free, and Save and Finish. An Offer can bundle multiple Products or use subscription pricing; creating content alone does not complete the checkout.

Payment-provider connection is a prerequisite to pricing the Offer. Pilot a real buyer’s route from sales page to checkout, confirmation and product access, including a failed payment and refund/revocation policy. None of those transactions were executed here. The short Assemble and Offer source was read as a written video synopsis, not viewed as a complete video tutorial.
sections.zh:
例如工作坊业务，可先创建课程或辅导体验，再定义销售用Offer。详细指南要求管理员进入Sales > Pricing > New Offer，输入标题、选择Product，在已连接支付服务时设置价格（或设免费），最后Save and Finish。Offer可捆绑多个Product或采用订阅价，内容创建本身不代表结账已完成。

连接支付服务是定价前提。试点应覆盖买方从销售页到结账、确认及产品访问的路径，包括支付失败和退款/撤销访问政策；本次未执行交易。Assemble and Offer短来源仅实读文字视频摘要，未观看完整视频教程。

sections.title_en: Choose the plan using products and contacts together
sections.title_zh: 结合产品及联系人选择套餐
sections.en:
The current table givesBasic5Products,2,500Contacts,1website,1community and2admin users;Growth50Products,25,000Contacts,1website,1community and11admins;ProunlimitedProducts,100,000Contacts,3websites,3communities and26admins. It lists unlimited marketing emails, landing pages, funnels and access groups, but those statements do not remove the contact or website caps.

The pricingFAQ says capacity can be added or the plan upgraded, with extra contacts sold in blocks of25,000for$125/month. Confirm how contact counts, archived/unsubscribed records, products and sites are measured before migration. Some feature rows use visual marks that were not reliably represented in the text extraction, so this record does not assign every API, code-editor or mobile-app entitlement from the flattened table.
sections.zh:
当前表格为Basic5产品、2,500联系人、1网站、1社区及2管理员；Growth50产品、25,000联系人、1网站、1社区及11管理员；Pro不限产品、100,000联系人、3网站、3社区及26管理员。页面列营销邮件、落地页、funnels及访问组无限，但不免除联系人和网站上限。

定价FAQ称可扩容或升级，额外联系人按每25,000人每月$125售卖。迁移前应确认联系人、归档/退订记录、产品及站点如何计数。部分功能表通过图形标记表达，本次文本提取未可靠保留，因此不从扁平文本给全部API、代码编辑器或移动应用权益指定套餐。

sections.title_en: Check the annual price against the actual checkout
sections.title_zh: 以实际结账核对年付价格
sections.en:
Monthly cards displayBasic$179,Growth$249andPro$499. The annual section shows highlighted monthly equivalents$143,$199and$399with advertised yearly savings of432,600and1,200respectively. However, its adjacent annual captions repeat the monthly rates, so the final prepaid annual total, currency and tax need checkout confirmation. These are displayed offers, not an invoice or a normalized verified rate.

TheFAQ says a trial moves to the selected plan afterward, permits upgrades/downgrades/monthly-to-annual changes and advertises a30-day money-back guarantee. A specific trial duration, renewal refund, unused-period proration and export/retention on cancellation were not verified. Cancel-anytime wording should not be treated as a tested immediate refund or a perpetual right to the hosted site.
sections.zh:
月付卡片显示Basic$179、Growth$249、Pro$499；年付区域高亮月均$143、$199及$399，宣传年省432、600及1,200。但旁边年付说明重复月付数字，实际预付全年金额、币种和税需结账确认。这些是页面显示报价，不是账单或规范化确认价。

FAQ称试用结束后进入所选套餐，可升级/降级/切换月年付，并宣传30天退款保证；本次未核实具体试用时长、续费退款、未用期比例退款或取消后导出/保留。“随时取消”不能当作已测试立即退款或永久保有托管网站的权利。

sections.title_en: Include the regional payment fees in revenue calculations
sections.title_zh: 收入计算包含区域支付费用
sections.en:
The fee table explicitly limits displayedKajabiPaymentscard rates toUSentities:Basic2.9%+$0.30,Growth2.8%+$0.30andPro2.7%+$0.30. Those are not global rates. It also displays additional third-party provider rates of2%,1%and0.5%, excludingPayPalandKajabiPaymentsand separate from the chosen provider’s own fees.

TheFAQ qualifies that additional fee: it applies whenKajabiPaymentsis offered in the region but a qualifying third-party provider is chosen; it says no such additional fee whereKajabiPaymentsis unavailable. A business must confirm entity/country/payment-method eligibility, subscriptions, refunds and other fees for its actual account. The headline of no platform revenue share does not mean zero payment costs.
sections.zh:
费用表明确将所列Kajabi Payments卡费限定美国实体：Basic2.9%+$0.30、Growth2.8%+$0.30、Pro2.7%+$0.30，不能作为全球费率。表中另列第三方服务附加费2%、1%和0.5%，排除PayPal及Kajabi Payments，并与所选服务自身费用分开。

FAQ进一步限定：所在区域提供Kajabi Payments、却选择适用第三方服务时才收该附加费；不提供Kajabi Payments的区域则无此额外费。业务需按实际账户确认实体/国家/支付方式资格、订阅、退款及其他费用。“平台不抽收入”不等于支付零成本。

sections.title_en: Test conditions, access changes and metered AI separately
sections.title_zh: 分别测试条件、访问变更及计量AI
sections.en:
The written automation introduction describes when/then logic with only-if conditions, reusable blueprints and centralized management. A useful pilot is a new-buyer action that grants the intended product and sends an appropriate onboarding message, then verifies repeat events and a contact that does not meet the condition. This example is editorial guidance; no trigger, social DM, email or automation was run.

The price table shows0/500/1,000AI credits forBasic/Growth/Proand a$15/month500-credit option. Expert Agents are markedComing Soon; one-time top-ups are described as forthcoming, andBackstage limits/pricing are still to be determined. Do not count those as settled production entitlements. Review generated lessons, captions and translations before publishing, and confirm credit reset, data handling and the exact automation feature scope.
sections.zh:
自动化文字介绍描述when/then逻辑、only-if条件、可复用blueprints及集中管理。试点可用新买方动作授予目标产品并发送入门消息，再验证重复事件和不符合条件的联系人。这是编辑建议，本次未运行触发器、社交私信、邮件或自动化。

费用表显示Basic/Growth/Pro分别0/500/1,000AI积分，另列每月$15购买500积分选项。Expert Agents标为Coming Soon，一次性充值描述为未来推出，Backstage额度/价格仍待定，不能作为已确定生产权益。课程、字幕及翻译生成后需复核，并确认积分刷新、数据处理和具体自动化范围。

content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.

未执行产品/客户账户、结账/支付/退款、自动化/邮件/私信、字幕翻译、API或内容导出；视频教程仅实读文字摘要。
